Basic chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Converse API response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"content":"Say hello in one word.","role":"user"}],"model":"bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0","temperature":0}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.chat(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.choices);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].message.content);
    println!("{:?}", result.choices[0].finish_reason);
    println!("{:?}", result.model);
    println!("{:?}", result.usage.as_ref().unwrap().total_tokens);
}
```
